decision: Engineering source admission for the exact base, source and tree. The reviewer did not author or modify the source, control a browser or operate the packaging or release lane.
method: Reviewed the full base-to-source path inventory and protected seams. Recomputed the embedded independent base-to-previous-source report digest and verified its direct admission-only child. Examined the 41-path successor diff, product and QA code, original release contract, build-61 evidence, packaging rules and safety boundaries. Recomputed a SHA-256 of the full NUL-delimited raw diff with full-length blob identities and no renames.
productionReview: A positive original attachment START remains durable. The ordinary history shows an accepted handoff; uncertain or weakly errored originals stay retained for inspection. A strongly attributed named original failure can return the asset. No positive final upload or send is inferred.

The history inspection uses the original browser process birth identity, native window/tab, document, composer and draft generation. Its page validation does not enter a file setter. Presence is advisory even when only a matching name remains. The warning permits returning to the draft or cancellation. An informed reselection still requires its own actual tray click, new operation, invocation and click binding.

Rechecked renderer and native action paths, explicit consent scope, generation and editor identity after asynchronous work, unique setter/change, persistence of old history, weak-error versus exact-original-card attribution, and read-only original observation after restart. The predecessor-only late record verifies original operation, PNG, target, invocation and known card, and cannot update the successor or invoke a setter.

The ongoing source preserves existing guarded transport and SQLite paths. Isolated AppKit/WebKit composition, fixtures and recovery controls live under Tests. No new release-browser interception, retry worker, cookie access, third-party request manipulation, product permission, vendor entitlement or automatic sending is introduced by this increment.

Read-only historical observation fingerprints for builds 56 through 61 are checked compressed and decoded. Historical executable JavaScript is not evaluated by this path. Build 62 resource validation pins the new archive and bounds the shipping page program.

Checked the additional weak-error-to-new-START chain against old and new operation, SHA, binding, invocation and original draft, with one input under each click.
